national_raw_news.title: 4 hours ago | National 443 Har Ghar Tiranga campaign begins with multiple events across country
national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 4:30 PM Har Ghar Tiranga campaign begins with multiple events across country The Har Ghar Tiranga campaign is being celebrated nationwide to foster a sense of patriotism among citizens, strengthen national unity, and promote India’s cultural heritage. The campaign marks the fifth year of the Har Ghar Tiranga initiative, which began in 2022 and has since evolved into one of the country’s largest public participation movements. The initiative is aimed at encouraging citizens to hoist the National Flag and participate in activities celebrating patriotism, national unity and India’s cultural heritage. This year’s campaign holds special significance as it coincides with the 150th anniversary of India’s National Song, “Vande Mataram,” bringing together the National Flag and the National Song in a unique celebration of patriotism. As part of the celebrations, mass singing of Vande Mataram will be organised across the country. In Delhi, as part of the campaign, Lok Sabha BJP MP Bansuri Swaraj paid floral tribute at the memorial of Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya in Malviya Nagar followed by a Tiranga Yatra from Pilanji Village to Greater Kailash. Speaking to the media, Ms Swaraj said that this Independence Day is particularly special as India marks its 80th. She added that the BJP has launched a week-long campaign starting today, during which party office-bearers and workers will visit the memorials of national heroes and martyrs. national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 4:30 PM Home Minister Amit Shah Flags Off Har Ghar Tiranga Yatra in Puducherry Union Home Minister Amit Shah today flagged off Har Ghar Tiranga yatra at Muruga Theatre Signal in Puducherry. Lt Governor K. Kailashnathan, Puducherry Home Minister A. Namassivayam, Agriculture & Farmers Welfare Minister G. N. S. Rajasekharan and BJP President V. P. Ramalingam were among those present on the occasion. Thousands of people participated in the rally with tricolour flags. Earlier, the Home Minister participated in the presentation ceremony of the President’s Police Colour to the Puducherry Police at the Police Training School ground in Gorimedu. Congratulating the Puducherry Police, Mr. Amit Shah said that receiving the President’s Police Colour is one of the most glorious moments in the life of any disciplined police force. He said that although the Puducherry Police has a strength of less than 5,000 personnel, it is entrusted with protecting Puducherry, maintaining its internal security and safeguarding the honour and dignity of the Union Territory, which has a rich spiritual heritage. With this historic recognition of the President’s Police Colour, Puducherry has become the 18th State/Union Territory in the country to be bestowed with this highest honour conferred upon a police force. Puducherry Lieutenant Governor K. Kailashnathan, Chief Minister N. Rangasamy, Home Minister A. Namassivayam and Director General of Police Shalini Singh were also present on the occasion. national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 1:50 PM NIA arrests one more accused in connection with seizure of huge consignment of illegal explosives in Malappuram, Keralam The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has arrested another accused in connection with the seizure of a huge consignment of illegal explosives in Malappuram, Keralam. The Agency informed that the accused was arrested yesterday from Manjeri in the Malappuram district. NIA said that the accused is a main conspirator and was involved in the illegal procurement of the explosives seized in the case. The latest arrest comes a day after the NIA arrested three more accused from Vijayapura in Karnataka on Friday, taking the total number of arrests in the case to ten. The case relates to the seizure of 89,600 explosive sticks and 10,500 shock tubes from a lorry parked in the compound of Farha Hollow Bricks Company on the Chemmad-Thalappara Road in Malappuram. NIA further said that investigation into the larger conspiracy and the illegal procurement and movement of the explosives is continuing. national_raw_news.title: Air India Phuket-Delhi flight case: Both Flight Crew Members Taken Off Roster
national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 7:37 PM Air India Phuket-Delhi flight case: Both Flight Crew Members Taken Off Roster The Ministry of Civil Aviation has said that the recent incident involving an Air India flight operating from Phuket to Delhi is under investigation by the Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau. The Ministry said the occurrence has been classified as a Serious Incident. The incident took place on the 4th of this month when the aircraft experienced a sudden loss of altitude of approximately 300 feet during cruise. The aircraft subsequently stabilised and landed safely in Delhi. A few passengers and cabin crew members sustained injuries during the incident. The Ministry said both flight crew members underwent the prescribed psychoactive substance screening test as part of the standard operating procedures. The test of the Pilot-in-Command indicated a result requiring confirmatory testing. Samples have accordingly been sent to a designated laboratory for further analysis, and the final report is awaited. Pending completion of the investigation and the prescribed procedures, the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) has taken both flight crew members off the roster. The Ministry said further action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation and the confirmatory test results. The Ministry of Civil Aviation and the DGCA reiterated their commitment to maintaining the highest standards of aviation safety. national_raw_news.title: Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu Rejects Trump’s 15-Point Gaza Plan
national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 7:50 PM Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu Rejects Trump’s 15-Point Gaza Plan Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has rejected US President Donald Trump’s 15-point plan for Gaza. Speaking at a cabinet meeting today, Prime Minister Netanyahu insisted that Israel will not withdraw its forces until Palestinian armed group Hamas is genuinely disarmed and it would continue to act against threats to Israeli forces and civilians. He said Israeli officials are now in discussion with US officials about how to move forward. President Trump’s Board of Peace last month said that it had reached an agreement aimed at the complete disarmament of Hamas in Gaza. However, Hamas has said that surrendering its heavy weapons would depend on Israel ending all forms of aggression and withdrawing its forces from the territory. Despite an initial ceasefire agreement reached last October, Israel has continued to carry out strikes in Gaza.
